answer: Auction scarce work slots each epoch: only a small lotus pool of slots opens, and identities bid locked stake for them, with winners priced by a falcon auction kernel that charges each winner the highest losing bid from a different funding graph. Clones from one operator bid against themselves, pushing their own price up with every extra bid, while losing bids stay locked for the epoch. One honest agent bids once at the market price; a farm pays an inflated price per slot and strands most of its stake locked and useless.
